import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sqrt(t)
    return (p[0]*s+p[1]*t + p[2]*P + p[3]*P**2 + p[4]*P**3
            + s*(p[5]*P + p[6]*P**2 + p[7]*np.sqrt(P) + p[8]*P*np.log(P))
            + p[9]*t*P**2)
